metadata.title: SME-FraudGuard Unit Test Cases
metadata.implementationStatus: Planned business-unit design; proposed SDD responsibilities are not implemented business functions.
metadata.executionNote: All cases are Not Run. Each parameterized case must run every variant before Pass; no test execution is claimed.

functions.setup: Mock account lookup, password verification and session store; no network or database.

scenarios.input: Valid OP-A credentials; active account; verified workspace A.
scenarios.expected: Return Operator destination and an A-scoped session; store no raw password.

scenarios.input: Valid first-login account; mustChangePassword=true.
scenarios.expected: Return setup-only session and mandatory password-change destination.

scenarios.input: Valid SME Admin; workspace not activated.
scenarios.expected: Return onboarding destination; grant no production authority.

scenarios.input: Unknown login OR wrong password (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Return the same safe authentication denial; create no session.

scenarios.input: Valid password but unavailable account OR wrong portal/workspace (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Deny login; do not derive membership from caller-supplied workspace.

functions.setup: Mock verified identity, account and credential store. Supply approved password policy at execution.

scenarios.input: Valid setup-only session; verified identity; policy-compliant matching new password.
scenarios.expected: Persist credential change and clear setup restriction only after successful save.

scenarios.input: Empty new password OR confirmation mismatch OR approved-policy violation (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject; do not clear first-login restriction or change the credential.

scenarios.input: Incorrect current-password/identity verification.
scenarios.expected: Reject credential change; preserve current credential.

scenarios.input: Credential persistence reports failure.
scenarios.expected: Return controlled failure; do not report credential changed or unlock setup.

scenarios.input: Ordinary account change with valid current verification and policy-compliant new password.
scenarios.expected: Update credential once; omit credentials from response and audit payload.

functions.setup: Mock server-side session lookup and termination.

scenarios.input: Current authenticated session S1.
scenarios.expected: End S1; later authorization using S1 is denied.

scenarios.input: Caller supplies another account's session reference.
scenarios.expected: Deny unauthorized termination; do not mutate the other session.

scenarios.input: Repeat termination of already ended current session.
scenarios.expected: Leave it ended; do not recreate authentication or delete business history.

functions.setup: Mock workspace/account repositories, uniqueness result and transaction boundary.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin; new enterprise; valid administrative metadata.
scenarios.expected: Create exactly one workspace and initial SME Admin requiring password setup; no activation.

scenarios.input: Existing workspace for the same enterprise.
scenarios.expected: Reject second workspace; preserve existing account/workspace.

scenarios.input: Staff or enterprise actor requests provisioning.
scenarios.expected: Deny; perform no provisioning writes.

scenarios.input: Initial SME Admin creation fails.
scenarios.expected: Report failure; do not expose partially provisioned workspace as usable.

functions.setup: Mock current assignments, workspace versions and administrative history.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin adds STAFF-A and STAFF-B to workspace A.
scenarios.expected: Retain concurrent assignments; expose setup metadata only.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin removes STAFF-A while STAFF-B remains.
scenarios.expected: Remove A access for STAFF-A on subsequent requests; retain STAFF-B and assignment history.

scenarios.input: Implementation Staff attempts to change its own assignments.
scenarios.expected: Deny; keep assignment state unchanged.

scenarios.input: Expected workspace version is stale.
scenarios.expected: Reject stale change; do not overwrite newer assignments.

functions.setup: Mock Platform Admin context and unactivated workspace entitlement store.

scenarios.input: Grant initial Subscription to unactivated workspace A.
scenarios.expected: Record allocation awaiting activation; no running validity term or production access.

scenarios.input: Grant initial Free plan according to permitted onboarding state.
scenarios.expected: Record Free allocation without readiness, approval or activation effects.

scenarios.input: SME Admin or Staff attempts initial grant.
scenarios.expected: Deny; no initial-plan mutation.

scenarios.input: Stale/invalid onboarding allocation request.
scenarios.expected: Reject conflicting update; preserve existing entitlement/history.

functions.setup: Mock own-workspace SME Admin, offer catalogue, purchase store and gateway port.

scenarios.input: Activated A; available monthly offer; synthetic quote 250000 VND.
scenarios.expected: Persist pending purchase with quoted amount/currency/period; initiate checkout; grant no rights yet.

scenarios.input: Operator or unactivated workspace requests purchase.
scenarios.expected: Deny before initiating checkout.

scenarios.input: Selected offer is retired.
scenarios.expected: Reject a new sale/renewal; preserve historical purchases.

scenarios.input: Catalogue price changes after pending purchase was quoted.
scenarios.expected: Retain that purchase's recorded quote; do not silently reprice history.

functions.setup: Mock server verifier and atomic purchase/entitlement repositories; no live gateway or money.

scenarios.input: Verifier authenticates success matching A purchase, provider reference, amount and currency.
scenarios.expected: Apply exactly one paid entitlement effect and retain verification history.

scenarios.input: Browser-only success flag; server verifier returns unverified.
scenarios.expected: Grant no entitlement.

scenarios.input: Verified event mismatches amount OR currency OR purchase/workspace OR provider identity (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject application; preserve current rights.

scenarios.input: Same verified successful provider payment is replayed.
scenarios.expected: Return prior applied outcome without extending validity again.

scenarios.input: Verified Pending, Failed and Cancelled events (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Record appropriate non-success state; grant no paid rights.

scenarios.input: Local entitlement write fails after verified success.
scenarios.expected: Expose recoverable failure; no false completion or second charge.

functions.setup: Inject authoritative clock; use UTC instants and Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh calendar calculations.

scenarios.input: Period [S,E); now=S.
scenarios.expected: Subscription is active at its inclusive start.

scenarios.input: Period [S,E); now is immediately before E.
scenarios.expected: Subscription remains active.

scenarios.input: Period [S,E); now=E.
scenarios.expected: Subscription is expired; new detection uses Free rules and new cases are denied.

scenarios.input: One-month term from 31 Jan 2027, 10:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
scenarios.expected: End on 28 Feb 2027, 10:00 local; persist the corresponding UTC instant.

scenarios.input: One-month term from 31 Jan 2028 OR one-year term from 29 Feb 2028 (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Clamp respectively to 29 Feb 2028 OR 28 Feb 2029, same local time.

scenarios.input: Paid renewal while active vs already expired (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Extend from current expiry when active; otherwise start from successful paid-entitlement activation.

functions.setup: Mock current Staff assignment, applied configuration, assessment and handover history.

scenarios.input: Assigned Staff assesses complete current applied setup.
scenarios.expected: Record readiness for Platform Admin review; do not activate workspace.

scenarios.input: Configuration changed since assessment or required setup is missing.
scenarios.expected: Reject readiness for outdated/incomplete configuration.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin approves a current readiness submission.
scenarios.expected: Record handover approval; initial Subscription still has not started.

scenarios.input: Approve without current readiness OR return without comments (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject; no activation eligibility from invalid review.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin returns submitted work with comments.
scenarios.expected: Retain comments/history and require renewed readiness/review.

functions.setup: Mock own-workspace SME Admin, readiness, approval, clock and atomic activation/entitlement writes.

scenarios.input: Current readiness and approval; initial Subscription allocated.
scenarios.expected: Activate once and start initial calendar term at committed activation time.

scenarios.input: Readiness absent OR approval absent/returned (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Keep production unavailable; do not start entitlement.

scenarios.input: Another workspace's SME Admin or browser activation flag.
scenarios.expected: Deny; trust server state and verified scope only.

scenarios.input: Already committed activation requested again.
scenarios.expected: Return existing activation; never restart or extend the initial term.

scenarios.input: Activation/entitlement persistence fails.
scenarios.expected: No partial operational workspace or unrecorded term start.

functions.setup: Mock SME Admin A, member store, current version and credential provisioning port.

scenarios.input: Create Operator or Investigator in A (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Provision one permitted-role account in A requiring initial password change.

scenarios.input: Attempt Platform Admin/Staff role or workspace B injection.
scenarios.expected: Reject before provisioning/mutating another workspace.

scenarios.input: Duplicate internal login identifier.
scenarios.expected: Reject duplicate; do not expose credential values.

scenarios.input: Permitted role/access change for A member.
scenarios.expected: Apply on subsequent requests; preserve historical authorship.

scenarios.input: Stale member version or unresolved responsibility blocks removal.
scenarios.expected: Reject affected change; retain current access/history until resolved.

functions.setup: Mock SME Admin A and member/field eligibility.

scenarios.input: Grant permitted field F to Operator A.
scenarios.expected: Save explicit grant and safe audit; grant SME Admin no plaintext access.

scenarios.input: Revoke field F from Investigator A.
scenarios.expected: Subsequent disclosure is denied even if a browser holds old permission.

scenarios.input: Target member in B or ineligible role.
scenarios.expected: Deny without changing any grant.

scenarios.input: Unknown/disallowed field or stale permission state.
scenarios.expected: Reject affected request; preserve current grants.

functions.setup: Mock currently assigned Staff, declared fields, current draft and active version.

scenarios.input: Valid field, mapping and flat typed rule change at current draft revision.
scenarios.expected: Save new draft revision/history; active configuration remains unchanged.

scenarios.input: Duplicate field OR undeclared mapping target OR incompatible operator/value (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject invalid draft input; identify safe field/configuration reference.

scenarios.input: Nested conditions, executable code or historical-window rule (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject unsupported rule; execute no supplied content.

scenarios.input: Toggle enabled flag of a rule in the draft.
scenarios.expected: Record new candidate revision; do not change production until apply.

scenarios.input: Stale revision or removed Staff assignment.
scenarios.expected: Reject; no overwrite of current candidate.

functions.setup: Mock exact configuration revision, shared validation/evaluation ports and temporary sample store.

scenarios.input: Valid temporary TEST-MAP-A samples and exact candidate revision R.
scenarios.expected: Return validation/rule counts for R; persist only safe run metadata.

scenarios.input: Expected invalid synthetic sample under a valid configuration.
scenarios.expected: Return row-level validation failure; do not label the configuration defective merely because negative data is rejected.

scenarios.input: Structural sample failure or inaccessible configuration.
scenarios.expected: Return controlled safe failure; no production writes.

scenarios.input: Evaluation completes or fails (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Clean temporary payloads/results under configured policy; retain safe metadata, not sample contents.

scenarios.input: Successful sample test.
scenarios.expected: Do not activate configuration, submit readiness, create transactions/alerts/cases or change statistics.

functions.setup: Mock current assigned Staff, locked draft/active versions, exact completed test and explicit assessment.

scenarios.input: Complete revision R; completed relevant test for R; explicit Staff assessment; expected active version matches.
scenarios.expected: Atomically activate R; retain old history; do not reactivate workspace or restart Subscription.

scenarios.input: Test refers to R-1 while current candidate is R.
scenarios.expected: Reject stale tested revision.

scenarios.input: No completed relevant test OR missing explicit assessment OR unresolved configuration error (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject apply; keep previous active version.

scenarios.input: Expected active version changed before apply.
scenarios.expected: Reject stale application; never overwrite newer active version.

scenarios.input: Previously accepted transaction T uses old version; another transaction accepted after apply.
scenarios.expected: T retains selected old context; new acceptance selects R.

functions.setup: Use synthetic TEST-MAP-A; mock field/mapping definitions. No global field schema is assumed.

scenarios.input: REST, Webhook and file equivalents with decimal 150000.25 and offset timestamp (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Return equivalent normalized business values with declared precision and timestamp meaning.

scenarios.input: Required configured value omitted.
scenarios.expected: Return validation failure; no accepted production record.

scenarios.input: Numeric text not parseable OR date violates declared format OR incompatible Boolean (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject invalid conversion without guessing or exposing sensitive raw values.

scenarios.input: Optional note omitted.
scenarios.expected: Accept absence as absent; do not invent a value.

scenarios.input: Mapping missing for selected channel or target field undeclared.
scenarios.expected: Reject incomplete configuration; do not infer fields from sample data.

functions.setup: Mock atomic identity store, verified workspace, plan/configuration snapshots and acceptance result.

scenarios.input: Fresh normalized identity X in A.
scenarios.expected: Accept exactly one durable transaction with selected plan/configuration context.

scenarios.input: Identity X in A with equivalent normalized content.
scenarios.expected: Return duplicate linked to original; no second transaction or detection trigger.

scenarios.input: Identity X in A with conflicting content.
scenarios.expected: Return conflict; preserve original values/history.

scenarios.input: Same business reference X in workspace B.
scenarios.expected: Treat as independent identity in B, never as A's duplicate.

scenarios.input: Store reports a concurrent equivalent acceptance won the identity race.
scenarios.expected: Resolve to existing accepted transaction/duplicate; no second effect.

scenarios.input: Acceptance persistence fails.
scenarios.expected: Do not acknowledge successful durable acceptance.

functions.setup: Mock approved sender verification/replay policy, activation and shared normalization/acceptance ports.

scenarios.input: Verified delivery D1, active A and valid mapped body.
scenarios.expected: Call common acceptance with verified A scope; distinguish acceptance from completed detection.

scenarios.input: Invalid sender/signature OR failed approved replay check (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject before business acceptance; safe diagnostic only.

scenarios.input: Repeated verified D1 with equivalent content.
scenarios.expected: Return safe prior outcome; no duplicate transaction effect.

scenarios.input: Different delivery D2 for the same normalized business transaction.
scenarios.expected: Delegate business identity deduplication; new delivery ID does not create a new transaction.

scenarios.input: Verified connection but workspace not activated.
scenarios.expected: Reject production acceptance.

functions.setup: Mock verified actor, current Staff assignment, workspace credential store and secret generator.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin or currently assigned Staff issues/replaces A key (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Bind key to submission-only A scope; return full secret only through approved issuance handling.

scenarios.input: SME Admin attempts issue/replace.
scenarios.expected: Deny issuance/replacement.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin, assigned Staff or SME Admin disables A key (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Disable permitted key; subsequent submissions using it are rejected.

scenarios.input: Other-workspace key or removed Staff assignment.
scenarios.expected: Reject mutation; omit full secret from logs/audit.

functions.setup: One enabled numeric rule, synthetic threshold T=1000000; fixed configuration and normalized values.

scenarios.input: Operator =; evaluate T-1, T, T+1 in separate invocations.
scenarios.expected: Match results: false, true, false.

scenarios.input: Operator !=; evaluate T-1, T, T+1 separately.
scenarios.expected: Match results: true, false, true.

scenarios.input: Operator > and >=; evaluate T-1, T, T+1 separately for each.
scenarios.expected: > gives false,false,true; >= gives false,true,true.

scenarios.input: Operator < and <=; evaluate T-1, T, T+1 separately for each.
scenarios.expected: < gives true,false,false; <= gives true,true,false.

scenarios.input: Optional numeric field absent; ordinary comparison including !=.
scenarios.expected: No ordinary comparison matches absence; do not coerce it to zero.

functions.setup: Mock declared types and active flat rules. Rule conditions are data, never executable code.

scenarios.input: Text =, !=, in and not-in against present typed value (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Return matching result for each specified operator/list without type guessing.

scenarios.input: Boolean true/false conditions with present matching/nonmatching Boolean inputs.
scenarios.expected: Evaluate declared Boolean meaning; no string truthiness.

scenarios.input: AND with all conditions true vs one false; OR with one true vs all false (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: AND: true,false; OR: true,false.

scenarios.input: Optional field absent; ordinary !=/not-in vs explicit has-no-value (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Ordinary comparisons false; explicit has-no-value true.

scenarios.input: Date/time comparison at equal UTC instant expressed using two different offsets.
scenarios.expected: Evaluate equality/order by normalized date/time meaning, not display-string order.

scenarios.input: A matching disabled rule plus two matching enabled rules.
scenarios.expected: Exclude disabled rule; collect both enabled reasons.

functions.setup: Mock evaluation/alert repositories and attempt reference; test service effect with no database.

scenarios.input: Three enabled rules match transaction T in attempt A1.
scenarios.expected: Persist one Rule Alert for A1 containing all three reasons; no case.

scenarios.input: Completed evaluation with zero matches.
scenarios.expected: Persist successful no-match; create no Rule Alert.

scenarios.input: Completion for A1 is replayed and alert already exists.
scenarios.expected: Reuse A1 alert; do not create another alert.

scenarios.input: Evaluator fails or configuration invalid.
scenarios.expected: Record controlled failure; do not report completed no-match.

scenarios.input: Matched condition includes protected field value.
scenarios.expected: Keep sensitive value out of default explanations and diagnostic payloads.

functions.setup: Mock AI port, rule evaluator, captured acceptance context and attempt/alert stores.

scenarios.input: Accepted Free context.
scenarios.expected: Invoke rules only; no AI invocation.

scenarios.input: Accepted Subscription; AI returns Normal plus model-test-v1.
scenarios.expected: Record AI Normal/version; no Rule evaluation or new AI Alert.

scenarios.input: Accepted Subscription; AI returns Anomaly plus version.
scenarios.expected: Create/reuse transaction AI Alert; no parallel rules or automatic case.

scenarios.input: AI unavailable, timeout, invalid classification or missing version (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Record unusable AI outcome and invoke rules as fallback; do not fabricate Normal or cancel Subscription.

scenarios.input: Both AI and fallback fail.
scenarios.expected: Preserve unresolved processing/attempt references; never call failure a successful no-match.

scenarios.input: Clock passes expiry after transaction was accepted under Subscription.
scenarios.expected: Use captured acceptance entitlement/configuration for this attempt; do not silently switch to Free.

functions.setup: Mock historical Subscription intervals, stored transaction/fallback, AI and alert store.

scenarios.input: Transaction time inside historical Subscription; current plan expired; AI Anomaly.
scenarios.expected: Add separate recovery attempt; create/reuse single transaction AI Alert; preserve Rule Alert; no automatic case.

scenarios.input: Transaction event time equals historical start vs equals expiry (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Start eligible; expiry ineligible under [start,expiry).

scenarios.input: Existing AI Alert/case; later recovery returns Normal.
scenarios.expected: Append Normal history; delete neither prior alert nor case.

scenarios.input: Replay same recovery operation or repeat Anomaly recovery.
scenarios.expected: Do not duplicate same operation effect or transaction AI Alert.

scenarios.input: AI fails during recovery.
scenarios.expected: Retain original fallback and append controlled recovery failure; no overwritten history.

functions.setup: Mock Operator A, current entitlement, AI Alert membership/link store and atomic case persistence.

scenarios.input: Active Subscription; two eligible unlinked AI Alerts in A.
scenarios.expected: Create one Open case with both links and history; no final conclusion.

scenarios.input: Free or expired Subscription (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject new case; leave existing cases/history untouched.

scenarios.input: Rule Alert origin or mixed-workspace AI Alert selection.
scenarios.expected: Reject without partial unauthorized links.

scenarios.input: AI Alert already linked, including a concurrently won link.
scenarios.expected: Reject second case linkage; preserve existing case.

scenarios.input: Case/history write fails.
scenarios.expected: No partial successfully opened case or orphaned links.

functions.setup: Mock current role, case scope/state, Investigator eligibility and optimistic version.

scenarios.input: Operator assigns Open A case to eligible Investigator A.
scenarios.expected: Record assignment/history and move Open to Investigating.

scenarios.input: Operator starts self-investigation of Open case.
scenarios.expected: Record Operator responsibility; move to Investigating.

scenarios.input: Reassign Investigating or Pending Review case to another eligible Investigator.
scenarios.expected: Preserve lifecycle and previous authorship; old Investigator loses subsequent access.

scenarios.input: Investigator attempts assignment OR target belongs to B OR case Closed (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Deny affected assignment; preserve case.

scenarios.input: Expected case version stale.
scenarios.expected: Reject stale assignment without overwriting current responsibility.

functions.setup: Mock own-workspace Operator/assigned Investigator, Investigating case and atomic report/history store.

scenarios.input: Assigned Investigator saves per-transaction findings/evidence.
scenarios.expected: Retain attributable protected findings; do not force one training label onto all transactions.

scenarios.input: Complete findings/proposed conclusion submitted from Investigating.
scenarios.expected: Retain report version; move to Pending Review; do not confirm final conclusion.

scenarios.input: Required findings/conclusion absent OR evidence unauthorized (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject; no invalid report or unauthorized reference.

scenarios.input: Assignment revoked or case state/version changed.
scenarios.expected: Reject stale write/submission even if browser still shows action.

scenarios.input: Existing authorized case; current Subscription expired.
scenarios.expected: Allow permitted investigation/submission; no new-case entitlement inferred.

scenarios.input: Report persistence fails.
scenarios.expected: Do not leave Pending Review without retained submitted report/history.

functions.setup: Mock Operator A and current Pending Review report/case version.

scenarios.input: Operator requests more work with comments.
scenarios.expected: Retain submitted report and review history; return Pending Review to Investigating.

scenarios.input: Operator confirms each supported conclusion in separate invocations.
scenarios.expected: Close with separate Confirmed Fraud / Anomalous but Legitimate / False Alert / Insufficient Evidence value; retain decision history.

scenarios.input: Same Operator investigated, submitted and now confirms its report.
scenarios.expected: Permit valid confirmation; no second-person requirement.

scenarios.input: Investigator/SME Admin confirms OR missing comments/conclusion OR stale report (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Reject; leave previous report/state unchanged.

scenarios.input: Conclusion/history persistence fails.
scenarios.expected: Do not close without a retained decision.

scenarios.input: Valid final confirmation completes.
scenarios.expected: Do not retrain/deploy AI, block accounts or cancel customer transactions automatically.

functions.setup: Mock current identity/workspace, field grants, case assignment, decryptor and value-free audit sink.

scenarios.input: Operator A with explicit grant requests permitted A field F.
scenarios.expected: Return only F after current object/field authorization; audit references, never plaintext.

scenarios.input: Investigator A with F grant and current case assignment.
scenarios.expected: Allow only assigned-case related F; no workspace-wide disclosure.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin, Staff or SME Admin requests reveal (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Deny plaintext regardless of administrative privileges.

scenarios.input: Grant revoked OR assignment removed OR other-workspace object (separate invocations).
scenarios.expected: Deny on current request; trust no stale browser grant.

scenarios.input: Decryptor or required audit persistence fails.
scenarios.expected: Return controlled failure without returning/logging plaintext.

functions.setup: Mock scoped query results, protected-field projection, export store and download authorization.

scenarios.input: SME Admin overview/report query vs Operator operational query.
scenarios.expected: Return role-appropriate A summaries; no risk score/severity or unauthorized transaction content.

scenarios.input: Permitted selected report/filter export.
scenarios.expected: Export only selected authorized result; reveal grant does not imply plaintext export.

scenarios.input: Access removed after generation but before download.
scenarios.expected: Deny download using current authorization.

scenarios.input: Input cell begins with =, +, -, @; HTML/script text in a display field.
scenarios.expected: Treat content as data under approved output handling; no formula/script execution.

scenarios.input: Generation fails or B result reference supplied.
scenarios.expected: Expose controlled failure/denial; never return another workspace's file.

functions.setup: Mock recipient policy, assignment, in-app store and email transport; no real messages.

scenarios.input: Case event with Operator and currently assigned Investigator recipients.
scenarios.expected: Create only relevant scoped minimal notices; include no sensitive payload or secrets.

scenarios.input: Account login identifier differs from contact email.
scenarios.expected: Deliver via stored contact email, not assumed login mailbox.

scenarios.input: Email transport fails after committed case/payment effect.
scenarios.expected: Record delivery failure; keep business outcome committed.

scenarios.input: Retry failed email delivery.
scenarios.expected: Retry notification only; never repeat case/payment mutation.

scenarios.input: Recipient follows old link after assignment/access removed.
scenarios.expected: Target authorization denies access; notification receipt is not permission.

functions.setup: Mock current object access, safe telemetry, transactional audit store and history query.

scenarios.input: Permitted business mutation emits audit payload.
scenarios.expected: Record actor/time/action/object/version without secret, plaintext or temporary sample contents.

scenarios.input: Required local audit write fails.
scenarios.expected: Fail corresponding atomic business mutation; do not report a complete unaudited change.

scenarios.input: Investigator requests history outside current assigned cases.
scenarios.expected: Deny underlying object/history access.

scenarios.input: Platform Admin requests operational health.
scenarios.expected: Return safe service/processing metadata only, no production/report/sample payload.

scenarios.input: Component telemetry absent or unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Return unknown/unavailable state, not healthy.
